excerpts.finding: All nine paragraphs were visually read. The suffering list, bare Name, sanctuary right/left, equal gifts and promises and some glory remain. Cleansing of shortcomings and all sins for those NOT double-minded is a definite future with the day qualification. The seating word is sympselion, not imported symplesion; its plaited inference is removed. Bright rod, bracketed You, tower on waters, square-cut shining stones, six builders and other myriads remain. Every deep stone fits, invisible joints/single-stone appearance, rejection/cutting/throwing, four unused-stone descriptions, road/no-road/fire/burning/water and inability/desire all remain. Only the seat word is corrected in the source; neighboring V3i is unchanged.

All nine paragraphs of the diplomatic transcription were read. Bare Name, sanctuary, both groups’ same gifts/promises and some glory remain. Negative double-minded and future cleansing remain. Bench word is sympselion; the rod is bright. You is printed in brackets, not counted as unbracketed preserved wording. Both six-builder numerals and other myriads remain. Joined deep stones, invisible joints and single-stone appearance remain. Rejected/built/cut/thrown groups, scabby/cracked/truncated/white-round descriptions and road/no-road/fire/burning/near-water inability and desire remain. No original photograph was newly collated.

All nine ab/app/rdg layers were read. In1 first taurous is corrected by S1 to staurous; prison/beast spelling also corrected. Bare Name, sanctuary, equal gifts/promises and some glory remain. In2 repeated copying material is removed by S1/ca, ca adds de and corrects the double-minded form; mē negative remains. In3 first article to has one unreadable character; S1 gives tou and the Lord abbreviation. The first vision word has another unreadable character plus a dotted letter; S1 gives horama. No supplied element occurs, but these are not wholly visible first-hand words. In4 sympselion and an unbracketed sy are present. In5 both first exēkonta, sixty, numerals are changed by ca to hex, six. In6 S1 corrects haul spelling; joints not visible and single stone remain. In7 cutting is followed by placing far, not throwing. In8 the opening lacks the fuller working other/many/around-tower wording but retains unused stones and descriptions. In9 first auto differs from road, anomian is corrected by S1 to anodian, and the burning/next-falling clause absent first is added by S1/ca; final rolling/coming forms also corrected. Correctors are not additional manuscripts.

All V3ii was visually read. Sufferings use his name, with God named in a qualifying clause; sanctity right/left, gifts/promises and some glory remain. Future cleansing has a negative doubt qualification and this-day extent. Appeal to Lord, raised-hand/left seating and bright rod remain; the corresponding sentence lacks an explicit woman-right-seat clause. Look/tower/over-waters/square-shining stones, both six numerals and many thousands remain. Every deep stone fits, invisible joints and one-stone tower remain. Rejection/building/cutting/throwing and unused stones remain, but printed16 lacks a separate truncated category. Scabby/cracked/white-and-round are present. Road/deserted-place, fire/burning, near water and inability despite desire remain. Apparatus omissions and edited forms are not additional codex votes.

All V3ii body was visually read. Sufferings use his name and the name of God, right/left sanctification, same gift and promise, some glory. Cleansing from shortcomings and negative doubt qualification retain this-day extent, with an imperative cleansing formulation in the Hermas clause. Appeal to Lord/left Hermas/right woman seating, long rod, look/tower/water/white-square stones remain. The rod’s longa is reported codex wording, not working bright. Both six-builder counts and many other men remain. Deep stones fit and join as one stone; rejection/building/cutting/throwing, scabby/cracked/small-reduced/white-round categories remain. Road/other road, fire/burning, near-water inability and strong desire remain. Edited forms are distinguished from reported codex grammar/spelling.

All V3ii was visually read through the Latin rendering. Suffering list uses his name, right/left holy-ones regions and same reward, with extra dignity at right. Hermas cleansing is imperative; all who are doubtful is POSITIVE in the printed main text. The footnote says negatives are often lost; that observation is not a preserved negative reading or direct Geʿez collation. Left Hermas/right woman, white rod, look/tower/water/white-square/four-sided imagery and six builders remain. Deep stones/joining/one-stone structure remain, with the edition’s own word-correction notes distinguished. Unused stones include shorter, white and round as separate formulations. Road/upper roads, fire/burning, near-water inability despite desire remain. This rendering is mediated evidence, not a separate Latin codex family.
